# Sample two coordinates of a curve

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The parameter t is sampled at \[0,1,2\]. Formulas \[2*t,t^2\] give the independent point pairs (0,0),(2,1),(4,4).

## What this example demonstrates

The parameter t is sampled at \[0,1,2\]. Formulas \[2*t,t^2\] give the independent point pairs (0,0),(2,1),(4,4).
